headline: Swedish Sawmill Industry Faces Waves of Closures Amid Sector Downturn
summary: Sawmill shutdowns are spreading across Sweden, with facilities closing in Urshult, Årjäng, and Skellefteå. Industry analysts at Skogsindustrierna report the worst sector conditions in decades.
why: Sweden is one of Europe's largest exporters of sawn timber and wood products, supporting housing construction chains.

impacts.name: Swedish Timber Industry
impacts.why: Widespread mill closures highlight severe contractions in timber market supply chains.
